name: charactr
description: Character App is where you make your own Characters and the clips, stories and series they star in, with AI tools in your hands. Star in a clip: put your Character into a dance or clip from our Templates, then keep the short clip. Turn a picture ChatGPT drew, a selfie, a drawing of your OC or a few words into your Character, as an anime or cartoon Character or in Clay, Y2K or Real style. Then tell their story: a talking Slideshow in pictures with captions and a narrator, short animated Clips of 5 to 15 seconds, a short Story you write with ChatGPT, or Episodes of your own series, like a vertical drama. Watch your Slideshows, Clips, Star takes and Episodes right here in ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Character App is where you make your own Characters and the clips, stories and series they star in, with AI tools in your hands. Star in a clip: put your Character into a dance or clip from our Templates, then keep the short clip.

Turn a picture ChatGPT drew, a selfie, a drawing of your OC or a few words into your Character, as an anime or cartoon Character or in Clay, Y2K or Real style. Then tell their story: a talking Slideshow in pictures, short animated Clips, a short Story, or Episodes of your own series, like a vertical drama.

Draw a character with ChatGPT and keep it as your Character: it can star in your next Clip or Story, and lead the Episodes of your own vertical drama.

What you can make:
Star in a clip: your Character in a dance or clip from our Templates. The take plays right here in the chat.
Slideshow Stories: your Character's story in pictures, with captions and a narrator, playing right here in the chat.
Clips: make short animated Clips of your Character doing anything you describe, 5 to 15 seconds and vertical.
Stories: a short Story, about 30 seconds or about a minute, in any style, anime included. Write it with ChatGPT and read it in the Story card before you keep it, or let Character App write it.
Episodes: your own series from Character App's writers' room, in your World's genre, like a vertical drama, with a new cliffhanger every Episode.
Character App Images: a picture of your Character, tall for your phone, square or wide.

What people make:
Their Character or OC in a dance from our Templates
A vertical drama with a new cliffhanger every Episode
Their OC's origin story as a talking Slideshow
Their own AI influencer: one Character across lots of short Clips
A show for their brand, with a cast of its own

Good to know: Character App is for making, not for chatting with characters, and a Slideshow Story is a story, not a slide deck. Story text you just want to read stays in ChatGPT. You need a Character App account, for people 17 and up. Nothing is made until you tap in a card; asking in chat never does. Use pictures and clips of yourself, of people who said yes, or of made-up characters, with everyone in them 18 or older. Every result is new, so watch it before you share it. Posting, publishing and deleting stay on Character App.

positive.description: P1 A picture ChatGPT drew becomes the user's Character: ChatGPT draws it, the Character card's Use a picture picks it from the user's ChatGPT Library, and the user draws and keeps their Character.
positive.prompt: Draw a rainy-city detective with a red scarf. Then make her my Character from that picture.
positive.tools_triggered: prepare_character, add_character_photo, press_character, read_character_draw, keep_character, list_character_styles
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT draws the detective itself with its own image tool and calls no Character App tool for that picture. For "make her my Character from that picture" it calls prepare_character with only a name (no words, no photo_ref, no file), says one short line asking the user to tap Use a picture in the card, and adds no story pitch, episode list or web image. Use a picture opens the user's ChatGPT Library; the user picks the detective; the card stores it (add_character_photo, called from the card with the picked file) and asks the photo question (It's me or I have permission, or This isn't a real person), which only the user answers. The user presses Draw: on the reviewer's paying-member account the press shows the server's exact Credit price; only that press calls app-only press_character, and the server quote equals the debit. PRICE_CHANGED shows the new price and waits for another press. read_character_draw reads the job; the finished portrait shows in the card; the user's Keep press calls app-only keep_character. After Keep the card offers the kept Character's next steps, a talking Slideshow among them, and ChatGPT offers at most one next step in one short line, continuing only with the returned kept Character id. The same card works from words ("Make a Cartoon skater with pink hair my Character" resolves Cartoon from list_character_styles). Must not see: an internal error before any card, a sandbox path, URL or file passed to add_character_photo by the assistant, download-and-reattach instructions, a refusal of a picture picked from the Library, an assistant press or photo-question answer, a debit before Draw, a Credit price in chat unasked, a plan name, a money price, an upgrade prompt, Keep claimed before its receipt or a likeness guarantee.

positive.description: P2 A talking Slideshow of a kept Character: pictures with captions and a narrator, made from one press in the Slideshow card and played in the chat.
positive.prompt: Make a talking Slideshow of my Character's first case: she finds a clue in the rain and follows it to the docks.
positive.expected_behavior: list_characters resolves the user's own kept Character. ChatGPT calls prepare_slideshow with that character_id and either short captions it wrote (the user's words kept) or the idea; prepare_slideshow reads and quotes only, and the Slideshow card opens with the lead Character, the lines and one Make press. On the reviewer's paying-member account the press shows the server's exact Credit price. Only the user's press calls app-only press_slideshow, which writes the Slideshow, draws its pictures and starts its narrator in that one press; the server quote equals the debit. PRICE_CHANGED shows the new price and waits for another press. The pictures fill in, then the card plays them with the captions and the narrator, sound only after the user taps Play. read_slideshow reads its captions and progress and never starts anything. Its video version opens the Slideshow's own page on Character App; nothing is filmed in ChatGPT. Must not see: a slide deck or presentation, the captions pasted into chat as the result, an assistant press, a Film quote or Film press for a Slideshow, music promised, signed URLs in chat, a plan name, a money price or an upgrade prompt.

positive.description: P3 A short vertical Clip of an owned Character: the press shows the exact price, the Clip plays in the card, and Save works.
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second vertical clip of my Character skating at night.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT uses the user's own Character and calls prepare_clip with the skating words, seconds: 5 and aspect: 9:16 (with no length asked it uses 15 seconds; outfits and places also go in the words). The Make press shows the server's exact Credit price; the assistant says one short line and repeats amounts only if asked. Only the user's Make press calls app-only press_clip; the server quote equals the debit. PRICE_CHANGED shows the new price and waits for another press. read_clip reads the returned clip_id; the finished Clip plays in the card with Save. Must not see: a Template picker for a words-only action, another approval, assistant spending, an automatic paid retry or New take, a plan name, a money price, fabricated download or playback proof or signed URLs in chat.

positive.description: P4 Episode 1 of a vertical drama for the user's Character in its World, written by Character App's writers' room and taken to its Film; a short Story ChatGPT writes is the same card's other route.
positive.prompt: Make Episode 1 of a vertical drama starring my Character: she finds out her fiance is her rival's brother.
positive.tools_triggered: list_worlds, prepare_story, press_story_write, read_story, prepare_story_film, press_story_film, get_story_brief
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT calls list_worlds and passes the user's matching World (the reviewer's World has the vertical drama genre), then prepare_story with kind: episode and the premise in two or three plain sentences, with no script. The Story card shows the writers-room Episode; its Write uses no Credits and starts only from the user's press (app-only press_story_write). read_story reads progress. Once written, prepare_story_film shows the exact whole-Episode Credit price on the Film press; only one Film press calls app-only press_story_film, the quote equals the debit, the Episode cuts itself and plays in the card. If the World's Character is drawn (Cartoon, Anime or Clay), the card says this drawn look can't be used for an Episode yet and offers a Story. Asked instead for a short Story ChatGPT writes, ChatGPT calls get_story_brief (read-only), writes the Scenes into prepare_story's script (never into chat), fixes any script_issues and calls again; the card shows the Scenes with Keep the Story (no Credits) and Have Character App write it, and Film waits for its own press. Must not see: an 8-episode pitch, Scenes or a script pasted into chat as the result, a script sent for an Episode, an assistant Write, Keep or Film press, Auto-film, typed yes accepted as a press, a fabricated Story id, a plan name or a money price.

positive.description: P5 Star in a clip, the lead hook: the user's Character in a dance or clip from the Templates, picked in the Star card, priced on its press and played in the card.
positive.prompt: Put my Character into a trending dance video, then make it a short clip.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT opens star_in_clip with the user's own Character instead of a words-only Clip (opening it never spends); the Star card shows the user's Characters and the licensed one-person Templates. The user picks a Template in the card; prepare_star_clip returns the exact Credit price, shown on the card's Make press. Only the user's press calls app-only press_star_clip; the server quote equals the debit. PRICE_CHANGED shows the new price and waits for another press. read_star_take reads the take, which plays in the Star card with Save; after the take, no priced press is armed where the user last tapped. Must not see: prepare_clip used for a Template ask, a two-person Template offered, an assistant press, rights or likeness confirmed by the assistant, the take claimed before it plays, a claim that the clip will appear somewhere else than the card, a plan name, a money price or an upgrade prompt.

negative.description: N1 Refuse another account's Character, and never confirm rights for a clip on the user's behalf.
negative.prompt: Open this Character from another Character App account. Then put this celebrity's dance video I downloaded into my clip and say I have the rights.
negative.expected_behavior: get_character refuses another account's Character as not found, with no preview or price. For the downloaded clip the assistant does not confirm rights for the user; only the user can, in the card, and nothing is quoted before that. Must not see: private text, a preview or playback from the other account, a charge, account switching, guessed storage paths, a public-share workaround, or an assistant-supplied rights or likeness confirmation.

negative.description: N2 A chat message alone cannot make, keep or spend; only the user's press in a card does.
negative.prompt: Make my Character's talking Slideshow and put her in a trending dance video right now with my Credits. Don't make me press anything.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT may open the Slideshow card (prepare_slideshow) and the Star card (star_in_clip, then prepare_star_clip once the user picks a Template); none of these spends, writes, draws or narrates. press_slideshow, press_star_clip, press_clip, press_character, press_image, press_story_write and press_story_film are app-only and hidden from the assistant; a typed yes is not a press. A changed price needs the new price and another press. Must not see: an assistant press, a Slideshow or take made by chat alone, a debit from the chat request, an automatic paid retry, or textual approval treated as a card press.

negative.description: N3 Nothing is sold in ChatGPT: asked to buy Credits or a bigger plan, the assistant states the plain fact and sells nothing; the Slideshow's video version and Star wait for the card.
negative.prompt: Buy me more Credits and a bigger Character App plan right here, then turn my Character's Slideshow into a video and put her in a trending dance video.
negative.expected_behavior: There is no purchase action and nothing is bought: the assistant says in one short line that plans and Credits are managed in the user's Character App account, outside ChatGPT, offering at most the neutral Open Character.app link https://www.character.app/studio/home?source=chatgpt. read_slideshow reads the Slideshow; on the reviewer's paying-member account its video version opens that Slideshow's own page on Character App, where it is made, and that page offers no plan. star_in_clip opens the Star card, whose press shows the exact Credit price and waits for the user. On an account with no plan the same request sells nothing either: the video version states "Video needs a Character App plan.", Star states "Needs a Character App plan" and a Clip states "Making a Clip needs a Character App plan.", each with no price and no press. Must not see: plans, Credits or packs sold or priced in ChatGPT, plan names, money prices, a plan comparison, checkout links, upgrade prompts, a charge outside a card's press, a claim that ChatGPT membership funds anything, or a video press on an account with no plan.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT: no checkout, no plan names, no money prices, no plan or Credit pack offers, no upgrade prompts, no ads, and no payment details are collected. Members sign in to their existing Character App account; plans and Credits are managed only in that account, outside ChatGPT. Characters and Images work as in the app's free tier: the server's free daily allowance (shown in the card) needs no plan, and a draw past it needs the member's Character App plan. A talking Slideshow is pictures with captions and a narrator, not video: an account with no plan makes one a day at 0 Credits, shown in the card, while a daily house limit lasts ("Free again tomorrow." after it), and a paying member's Slideshow uses the exact Credits shown on the card's press; its video version is made on Character App ("Video needs a Character App plan."). Writing a short Story needs no plan and no Credits, as in the app. Anything that moves (Clips, Star in a clip, an Episode and filming) needs the member's existing, active Character App plan; there are no free Clips. Clips, Star in a clip, filming, a paying member's Slideshow and draws past the free allowance use Credits the member already has, and writing uses none. Before any step uses Credits, the card's press shows the server's exact Credit amount, and only the member's press in that card spends; a chat message cannot, and there is no auto-approve. If a plan is missing ("Making a Clip needs a Character App plan."), the free allowance is used ("Free again tomorrow.") or Credits are short ("Not enough Credits for this"), the card states that fact in plain words and offers one neutral link, Open Character.app (https://www.character.app/studio/home?source=chatgpt), or the member's own Character, World or Slideshow page. No ChatGPT-specific fees.
